title: Moody's embeds connected intelligence in the platforms where customers build with AI
body_markdown:
NEW YORK -- (BUSINESS WIRE) -- Moody's Corporation (NYSE: MCO) today announced zero-copy data sharing, a new way for customers to access Moody's connected intelligence directly in the platforms where they build AI agents, models, and analytics, without moving or duplicating the data. Alongside Moody's existing Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors, it puts Moody's intelligence where customers already work and build, available from Moody's or through Snowflake Marketplace.


Moody's connects companies and relationships across more than 650 million public and private entities and over 2 billion ownership links, giving customers a holistic view of how organizations, people, and ownership structures relate. Moody's connected intelligence was recently ranked #1 overall in the Chartis RiskTech100® for the fifth consecutive year.


"As AI increasingly informs consequential decisions, the quality, context, and freshness of the intelligence behind it matter even more," said **Cristina Pieretti, Head of Digital Content & Innovation at Moody's Analytics** . "With zero-copy data sharing, we are bringing Moody's decision-grade intelligence directly into the environments where customers build, so the decisions AI supports rest on intelligence they can trust."


Zero-copy data sharing delivers data at scale for large, continuous workloads. It complements Moody's MCP connectors, which give AI agents access to Moody's intelligence on demand when a question or task calls for it.


Both approaches are available to customers through Moody's solutions or via Snowflake Marketplace, where customers can access Moody's data in their own Snowflake accounts as continuously updated, ready-to-query tables covering company firmographics, financials, ownership structures, credit ratings, and daily probability-of-default measures. Through Snowflake, MCP connectors also give AI agents access to Moody's credit intelligence.


"Our collaboration with Moody's is making it easier for customers to bring trusted data and insights into the environments where they work," said **Rodrigo Rocha, Vice President, Global ISV & Enterprise Technology Partnerships at Snowflake** . "With Moody's data and MCP connectors now available through Snowflake Marketplace, customers can bring Moody's entity and ownership data into credit risk and counterparty risk analysis alongside their own data, and feed it directly into their models and AI agents."


Moody's connected intelligence combines proprietary data, research, analytics, models, and company registry data across 200+ jurisdictions. It is curated, normalized, and enriched with traceability to authoritative sources. That is the trusted context layer that helps make AI outputs more explainable and auditable, wherever they are delivered.


To learn more, visit[moodys.com/agentic](https://www.moodys.com/web/en/us/capabilities/gen-ai/agentic-solutions.html?cid=pa-prgrmmtcds-19243) .
